notes: The packet's only change adds requires = ["gui-input"] and requires_interfaces = ["k2.guiinput@1"] to the inventory-3d-viewport manifest. I checked the required side: patch_manager_mods/gui_input_src/manifest.toml has id = "gui-input" and provides = ["k2.guiinput@1"], so the dependency name and interface string match exactly. No issue found. Two things I did not verify: (1) that KPM resolves requires_interfaces and loads gui-input before this mod (that needs the KPM loader source, which is outside this packet); (2) gui-input lists both kotor2_steam_aspyr and kotor2_gog_aspyr while this mod lists only the Steam hash. That is narrower and not a conflict, but it means the mod will not load on GOG, which is consistent with the Steam-only supported_versions. The checker facts (build_check PASS, common_contract_test PASS) do not exercise manifest dependency resolution. No secrets were touched.
